question: Does manuscript Algorithm 1 discover a useful first-layer sharing rule on real pen or speech trajectories when a new task supplies only two examples per digit?
prediction: If target discriminants vary slowly along part of a trajectory, sharing nearby coefficients can reduce estimation variance at small support. Input adjacency alone does not imply optimal weights are equal. We expect a learned advantage over untied Dense only if its bias costs less than the variance reduction. Comparison to input-row permutations tests the particular assignment; comparison to fixed temporal bins tests whether labeled source fits add value over known geometry.
primary: Mean paired 10-way 2-shot accuracy difference for validation-selected Algorithm 1 minus validation-tuned full Dense. Two datasets, two-sided Bonferroni 97.5% t intervals. A practically noticeable result requires a point gain of at least 1 percentage point and an interval excluding zero. Report both datasets regardless of sign.
secondary: Use the same frozen structures and numerical settings at 5 shots. Report paired 95% intervals for controls, including the same-budget temporal prior, narrow Dense, four row permutations, four uniform single-background masks, source-pretrained Dense, and Algorithm 2 versus unfiltered selection from its identical bank. Average scores over permutations, not predictions.
construction: Fit one source Dense task per training writer or ten-utterance position block. Use three independent starts per task and the lowest numerical-validation CE checkpoint of each. Normalize and align within and between tasks using the reference with lowest numerical-validation loss as in Algorithm 1. Offer the global signed Ward and the common-input Ward at all four budgets. Fit all numerical target parameters afresh. Rank by mean 2-shot selection accuracy, then lower half-Brier, smaller budget, fewer updates, lexical candidate name. Optimize the Dense stop on exactly the same episodes. Freeze before test inference.
baselines: For each candidate budget include a narrower untied Dense with exactly the same number of numeric first-layer weights, and channelwise adjacent temporal bins with the same total codes. Tune each stopping time on selection. Pooled Dense learns all ten shared class labels on the same source recordings with three starts; select its best source checkpoint and choose 0/25/75/200 full-network adaptation steps on development. Random controls use Algorithm 1's chosen stopping time. Row permutations are shared across all neurons, keep original signed labels and code draws. Single-background masks use one shared positive code and m-1 uniformly sampled singleton weights.
compatibility: At Algorithm 1's chosen budget and stopping time form one prespecified secondary bank: global Ward, common-input Ward, and sixteen four-block hybrids from the existing implementation using four separate input Ward partitions. Remove structurally identical maps. Use epsilon .01 in half-Brier; all six discovery writers or all 192 discovery speech episodes must admit one full witness per relation set. Select completion by accuracy on separate selection data; also select from this entire bank without filtering. Both are compared on the same tasks.
measurement: Each episode has 12 separate query examples per digit. Pair support, queries and numerical seed across methods. For each target person or episode batch draw independent initializations over batches; average before inference over 14 official test writers on PenDigits or over 64 batches of 32 independent episodes conditional on the official test speech pool. Disjoint query and support inside each episode. No target labels in the forward or training call. Save frozen choices and hashes of prediction files before scoring.
structure_diagnostic: Describe the fraction of adjacent input points from the same measurement channel assigned the same signed code in the selected indexator and its four row permutations, and the mean source Pearson correlation of adjacent time points.

pen.features: Official eight arc-length samples, x and y, no upsampling. Join writer metadata of raw records to the official feature table and verify every digit label.

spoken.features: Interpolate each of the 13 official MFCC trajectories to 16 equally spaced points in normalized time. No data augmentation, durations or extra features. Standardize both corpora using only source-fit examples.
spoken.tasks: Official speaker-disjoint train/test corpora. Training files contain digit and sex strata, no explicit speaker IDs. Partition ten-utterance position blocks within each sex across training, discovery and selection before fitting. Pool across available recordings in each development and test phase. Inference is conditional on the 22 test speakers' recording pool; episodes are not treated as new speakers.
